clips.title: The story
paras: Travelers leave Shadowglen with a parcel of herbs bound for Dolanaar. Porthannius, occupied with the druids, asks them to carry it south, marking their first venture beyond the sheltered glade.

Porthannius asks travelers heading south from Shadowglen to carry a bundle of freshly harvested herbs along the forest path. He is occupied with pressing business alongside the druids tending the glade, and cannot leave to handle the errand himself. The bundle goes south as young adventurers prepare to leave the training grounds for the wider reaches of Teldrassil.

The southern road from Shadowglen leads to Dolanaar, a foremost night elf settlement on Teldrassil's great boughs. Innkeeper Keldamyr oversees hospitality, rest, and supplies for wanderers, sentinels, and druids. When he receives the herbs on Porthannius's behalf, he urges young adventurers to rest their minds and spirits before facing the corruption spreading across the world tree.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Greetings, young hunter. Can you offer me aid? I have a package of herbs that I must deliver to the town of Dolanaar. But I still have business with the druids of Shadowglen and cannot yet leave.
Can you deliver this package for me? It must be sent to Innkeeper Keldamyr, at the Dolanaar inn. It lies along the road, to the south.

clips.title: Progress
paras: How might I be of service to you, young one? Are you here to rest in the inn? Do you require a hearthstone?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah yes, the delivery of herbs from Shadowglen. It is a shame Porthannius could not bring it himself, for we have much to discuss, he and I. But I am glad to get the herbs nonetheless, and I am glad you came.

While you are here, please, rest yourself. Heroes must keep their strength and spirits high, and must find rest and solace whenever they may. For to neglect one's peace of body and mind is a sure path to failure.
